title: Longer Strength II Potions
description: Changes level 2 strength potions to last 8 minutes instead of 1.5 minutes
body:
This lightweight datapack makes Strength II potions, splash potions, lingering potions and tipped arrows last longer. The duration becomes the same as a long level 1 of its type.

_This mechanic was inspired by Lifesteal World, where Strength II splash potions would last 8 minutes_


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

_The potions will look 1.5 minutes when they have been brewed and are still in the brewing stand, but they will work as intended as soon as they enter a player's inventory._

</details>
